items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh yeah, very well. We played a set together up in New York.

ctx.x: Joe Lovano’s down there tonight. You know him?
Oh yeah, very well. We played a set together up in New York. He’s a very nice man, nice horn player. I maybe can get down, but I just don’t know. It’s all according to what changes I go through here.
You mentioned before that you were on the road with Richard Prior. Was that . . .
